text:
Anna: quick ping — can someone eyeball my PR that tweaks KV cache TTL + batcher fallback logic? small change but touches the hotpath and we want to merge during today's window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4829
Micah: i'm mid-scrub but can do a pass in ~45m. any perf numbers?
Anna: unit + smoke passed locally. perf: ~0.6% tail latency improvement on 1k-seq bench. main risk is double-prefetch on fallback path; added a guard and tests.
Julia: ok i'll take a quick look now, can you squash the last WIP commit?
Anna: done — rebased & squashed. thanks.
Kevin: quick nit: KVCache::get docstring needs a small tweak to mention behavior on miss, otherwise looks good. can we canary this at 10% for 2 hours?
Micah: +1 to canary. i can flip the rollout to 10% after merge and watch tail/p99. FYI CI had a gpu-runtime-test flake earlier but rerun passed. @CI-Bot any remaining failures?
CI-Bot: all checks passing — build 4829.2 ✅
Julia: approved. please add a short note in release notes about changing the TTL default and the fallback semantics.
Anna: will add a brief release-note blurb. planning to merge at 16:00 PT unless anyone objects. thanks y'all :rocket:
Micah: ack, i'll monitor canary metrics after rollout and revert if we see regression.
